preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::3]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of elements n in the multisets a and b is between 1 and 2 * 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::3])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the multiset a are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::3])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all elements in the multiset b are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of n values over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip().upper() == 'YES' if can_transform(a, b) else stdout.strip().upper() == 'NO' for a, b in zip(parse_multisets(stdin)[0], parse_multisets(stdin)[1]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if the multiset b can be transformed into the multiset a using the allowed operations, otherwise 'NO'.
